introduction.text: Common Sense Odisha (CSO): Complete Jobs, Recruitment & Career Explorer Directory

The best approach is to merge Jobs & Recruitment, Career Explorer, Eligibility Explorer, Courses & Examinations, Scholarships, International Opportunities, and Career Development into one connected directory.

This will be the master structure for CSO. It covers opportunities in Odisha, across India, in the private sector, and internationally. For now, it contains categories, subcategories, and further subcategories only—individual job notifications, vacancy details, career profiles, and scholarship entries can be added later.
Master directory overview
01. Jobs & Recruitment
National, Odisha state, other states, private, international, contractual and remote jobs.
02. Career Explorer
Careers by qualification, subject, sector, occupation, and future opportunities.
03. Eligibility & Qualification Explorer
Age, qualifications, marks, experience, reservation, physical standards and licensing.
04. Courses, Entrance Exams & Certifications
Academic pathways, competitive examinations, professional courses and skill training.
05. Scholarships & Financial Support
Government scholarships, fellowships, international funding, fee waivers and loans.
06. International & Overseas Opportunities
Overseas jobs, education, research, internships, migration and global organisations.
07. Career Development & Employability
CVs, interviews, skills, career planning, salary information and entrepreneurship.
08. Institutions, Official Portals & Verification
Universities, regulators, recruitment authorities, application portals and fraud prevention.

reference.text: Recommended final website hierarchy
The complete directory can be organised into these eight main navigation sections.
1. Jobs & Recruitment
National · Odisha · Other States · Private · PSU · International · Remote
2. Career Explorer
Qualification · Subject · Sector · Occupation · Career pathways
3. Eligibility Explorer
Age · Qualification · Marks · Category · Experience · Licensing
4. Courses & Examinations
Courses · Entrance tests · Recruitment exams · Certifications
5. Scholarships & Funding
Odisha · Central Government · Research · International · Financial aid
6. International Opportunities
Jobs · Study · Research · Fellowships · Migration · Worker protection
7. Career Development
Career planning · CV · Interviews · Skills · Salary · Entrepreneurship
8. Institutions & Official Resources
Institutions · Authorities · Official portals · Verification · Glossary
How the directories will connect
For example, a student exploring a teaching career would follow this pathway:
Career Explorer
School teacher
Eligibility Explorer
Required qualification and applicable eligibility test
Courses & Examinations
B.Ed, CTET, OTET, OSSTET or other relevant pathways
Jobs & Recruitment
Relevant national, Odisha, other-state or private vacancies
Official Resources
Original notification, application portal and verification
Important rules for maintaining the directory
One career, many opportunities: A career such as teaching should have one core career profile linked to multiple recruitment notices.
One opportunity, several filters: A recruitment notice can be discoverable by location, qualification, sector, exam and applicant group without being duplicated.
Separate permanent information from changing notices: Career descriptions and qualification pathways are relatively stable; vacancies, deadlines and exam dates must be updated.
Keep international opportunities distinct: Overseas employment, study, immigration and worker protection have different requirements and should have separate subdirectories.
Prioritise official sources: Government notifications and official application portals should be the primary references for recruitment and eligibility.
Build the directory before adding entries: Create the structure first, then populate individual careers, vacancies, scholarships and institutions later.
Use a consistent classification system: Each entry should have one primary category and can carry several additional tags.

My recommendation: Use this as the proposed master directory for CSO. Keep the eight sections visible to users, with the 36 numbered categories as the detailed internal structure. This provides broad coverage without turning the homepage into an overwhelming list.
